audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. H427-SCALE: Verified counterexample to the stated general-preconditioner extension; H427-ALG4: Actual typeset discrepancies confirmed; retained code provides scope-limiting counterevidence; H427-C40: Verified false numerical inference; qualitative output theorem not disproved
limitations: H427-SCALE: Verified counterexample to the stated general-preconditioner extension — Counterevidence and scope: The construction violates the absolute normalization of Lemma 6.3. It does not refute Theorem 6.1 with sketch-QR normalization, Theorem 7.1's correctly specified main FOSSILS method, or the corresponding normalized SPIR mechanism.

H427-ALG4: Actual typeset discrepancies confirmed; retained code provides scope-limiting counterevidence — Counterevidence: Algorithm 2 / formula (2.10) use beta=eta^2. Retained fossils.m line 32 uses size(c,1)/d, equal to n/d at full rank.
H427-ALG4: Actual typeset discrepancies confirmed; retained code provides scope-limiting counterevidence — Counterevidence: Retained metasolver.m keeps scale=vecnorm(A) and returns x./scale.'.

H427-ALG4: Actual typeset discrepancies confirmed; retained code provides scope-limiting counterevidence — Counterevidence: Retained metasolver.m uses loop==2 and mod(i,5)==0, where i is the inner iteration index.

H427-ALG4: Actual typeset discrepancies confirmed; retained code provides scope-limiting counterevidence — Counterevidence: Retained code forms the regularized residual right-hand side, and RAAR applies V'*(A^T A z+reg^2 z) divided by sreg; fossils.m subtracts this normal operator in c-Ady.
Limit: The loose final inequality may still hold. No independent defect count or false-output-bound claim follows from this identity alone.
Limit: No counterexample to the final theorem is asserted from these obvious local transcription issues.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
